context:
Goal: sessions find this page on their own.
Problem: a session finds the page through a key in .claude/layout-extras.json. That same file also tells every shared tool that mailaudit has moved to the shared folder layout (decisions and debts under docs/). mailaudit keeps them at the root. Adding the file alone would point the shared tools at folders that do not exist.
Based on: lint/layout.py rolled_out() and lint/layout.json (read).
Meanwhile: I put this page's link in my handoff note and in each question box.
home: the 10-26 orchestrator handoff note, then a mailaudit record

options.gain: No shared tool changes its verdict on mailaudit today.
options.how: The page works now through my handoff note. A later lane moves decisions/ and debts/ under docs/, updates check-records and CLAUDE.md, then adds the key.
options.label: Link later, with the layout move
options.lose: Other sessions only find the page through my handoff until the move.

options.gain: Every session finds the page on its own.
options.how: One record-and-check lane moves the folders and adds the key, in parallel with the restyle.
options.label: Do the layout move now
options.lose: A large rename lands while the card lanes edit CLAUDE.md, so merge conflicts are likely.

ref: skill waiting-page (one page per repo); layout-extras.json (the file that marks a repo as moved to the shared folder layout)
title: Link this page from mailaudit now, or with a layout move later?
why: The restyle is the priority, and the move touches every record path while three lanes edit CLAUDE.md.
